ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure has the outlines and latitude-longitude positions of four peninsulas or islands labeled A, B, C, and D. Map C is located in the Southern Hemisphere, with marked latitudes of about 40°S—50°S and longitudes of about 170°E—180°, and the outline appears as two large long and narrow islands. Then reason: This latitude-longitude position and the form of two large islands correspond to New Zealand. New Zealand is dominated by a temperate maritime climate, with a mild and humid climate, suitable for pasture growth, and developed animal husbandry, so rich grassland pastures can be enjoyed near location C.
